title: Complete a valid reservation and reach payment
description: A guest can submit a valid booking form and continue to the payment page after the reservation is created.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservar/estandar
Fill a valid check-in date into the check-in date field
Fill a valid check-out date into the check-out date field
Fill the guest full name field with a valid name
Fill the email field with a valid email address
Fill the mobile number field with a valid Colombian mobile number
Fill the guest count field with a valid number of guests
Click to continue to payment
Verify the payment page is displayed
Verify the reservation summary is displayed

title: Complete an approved sandbox payment and see confirmed status
description: A guest can finish a sandbox payment and return to the result page with a confirmed reservation status.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas/[id]/pago for an existing reservation
Click to start payment with PayU
Enter the approved sandbox card details
Submit the sandbox payment
Return to the hotel site
Verify the result page is displayed
Verify the reservation is marked as confirmed

title: Browse room catalog and start a reservation
description: A guest can review the three available rooms on the home page and open the booking flow for a selected room.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the three room cards are displayed
Click the link to reserve one of the rooms
Verify the booking form for that room is displayed

title: Open the PayU sandbox checkout from a reservation
description: A guest can start the PayU sandbox checkout from the payment page.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas/[id]/pago for an existing reservation
Click to start payment with PayU
Verify the PayU sandbox checkout page is displayed

title: Complete a rejected sandbox payment and see rejected status
description: A guest can finish a sandbox payment and return to the result page with a rejected reservation status.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas/[id]/pago for an existing reservation
Click to start payment with PayU
Enter the rejected sandbox card details
Submit the sandbox payment
Return to the hotel site
Verify the result page is displayed
Verify the reservation is marked as rejected

title: Ver estado y detalle de una reserva en el resultado del pago
description: Verifica que la página de resultado muestre el estado de una reserva junto con sus datos principales y el identificador de transacción cuando existe una reserva válida.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas/1/resultado
Verify a reservation status is displayed
Verify the reservation reference, room, dates, total, and transaction identifier are displayed

title: Open the Standard room booking flow from the catalog
description: A guest can start a reservation for the Standard room from the catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to reserve the Standard room
Verify the booking form for the Standard room is displayed

title: Open the Suite Aurora booking flow from the catalog
description: A guest can start a reservation for the Suite Aurora room from the catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to reserve the Suite Aurora room
Verify the booking form for the Suite Aurora room is displayed

title: Actualizar el estado mostrado en el resultado del pago
description: Verifica que al volver al resultado de una reserva el estado visible se actualice con la información más reciente almacenada.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas/1/resultado
Wait for the payment result page to finish loading
Refresh the result page through the page controls
Verify the latest reservation status is displayed
Verify the reservation summary remains visible

title: Review reservation summary before paying
description: A guest can open the payment page and review the reservation reference, room, nights, and total before starting PayU checkout.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas/[id]/pago for an existing reservation
Verify the reservation summary is displayed
Verify the payment action is available

title: Ver el listado de reservas ordenado por fecha
description: Verifica que la lista de reservas muestre las reservas más recientes primero y permita abrir el resultado de una reserva.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas
Verify reservations are displayed in descending creation order
Verify each reservation row provides access to its result page

title: Permitir reintentar un pago rechazado
description: Verifica que una reserva con pago rechazado muestre la opción de reintento y genere una nueva referencia para pagar otra vez.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas/1/resultado
Wait for the payment result page to finish loading
Click the option to retry the payment
Verify a new payment reference is displayed
Verify the payment page for the reservation is available

title: View the reservations list ordered by newest first
description: Reception can open the reservations list and see reservations ordered by creation date with access to each reservation detail.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas
Verify the reservations list is displayed
Verify the reservations are ordered from newest to oldest

title: Abrir el resultado de una reserva desde el listado
description: Verifica que desde el listado de reservas se pueda abrir una reserva específica y revisar su resultado.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas
Click the access point for one reservation result
Verify the reservation result page is displayed
Verify the selected reservation details are shown

title: Open a reservation from the reservations list
description: Reception can open a reservation from the list and review its detail or result page.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas
Click a reservation in the list
Verify the reservation detail or result page is displayed

title: Show live nights and total while booking
description: A guest can see the number of nights and the total price update while completing the reservation form.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservar/superior
Fill a valid check-in date into the check-in date field
Fill a valid check-out date into the check-out date field
Verify the nights calculation is displayed
Verify the total price calculation is displayed

title: Reject a booking with an invalid date range
description: A guest cannot continue when the check-out date is earlier than the check-in date and sees a date validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservar/estandar
Fill a valid check-in date into the check-in date field
Fill an earlier check-out date into the check-out date field
Fill the guest full name field with a valid name
Fill the email field with a valid email address
Fill the mobile number field with a valid Colombian mobile number
Fill the guest count field with a valid number of guests
Click to continue to payment
Verify a date validation error is visible

title: Mostrar la página personalizada de no encontrado en una reserva inexistente
description: Verifica que una reserva inexistente muestre la página personalizada de no encontrado y ofrezca una salida al catálogo.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas/does-not-exist/resultado
Verify a custom not found message is displayed
Verify a link back to the catalog is available

title: Reject a booking with a past check-in date
description: A guest cannot continue when the check-in date is in the past and sees a validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservar/suite-aurora
Fill a past check-in date into the check-in date field
Fill a valid check-out date into the check-out date field
Fill the guest full name field with a valid name
Fill the email field with a valid email address
Fill the mobile number field with a valid Colombian mobile number
Fill the guest count field with a valid number of guests
Click to continue to payment
Verify a check-in date validation error is visible

title: Ver el estado vacío del listado de reservas
description: Verifica que cuando no existen reservas la página muestre un estado vacío claro en lugar de una tabla.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify the reservations table is not displayed

title: Handle an unknown route with the custom not-found page
description: A visitor reaching an unknown route sees the custom not-found page and can return to the catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to an unknown route
Verify the custom not-found page is displayed
Verify a link back to the catalog is available

title: Volver al catálogo desde la página de no encontrado
description: Verifica que desde una página de no encontrado se pueda regresar al catálogo de habitaciones.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservas/does-not-exist/resultado
Click the link to return to the catalog
Verify the room catalog is displayed
Verify the three rooms are visible

title: Show field validation errors for invalid guest details
description: A guest sees field-level validation errors when entering invalid email, mobile number, or guest count information.

steps.description: Navigate to /reservar/superior
Fill a valid check-in date into the check-in date field
Fill a valid check-out date into the check-out date field
Fill the guest full name field with a valid name
Fill the email field with an invalid email address
Fill the mobile number field with an invalid mobile number
Fill the guest count field with an invalid number of guests
Click to continue to payment
Verify field-level validation errors are visible
Verify the booking cannot proceed
